input_configuration.quote: adservice Deployment (boutique) exposes gRPC on container port 9555. The readinessProbe uses grpc on port 9555 (initialDelaySeconds 5), while the livenessProbe uses httpGet on path / port 9555 (initialDelaySeconds 5). Since the container serves gRPC, the HTTP-based liveness probe is a protocol mismatch that can cause repeated probe failures and container restarts. Resources: 200m/180Mi requests, 300m/300Mi limits; Service is ClusterIP grpc 9555->9555.

output_reasoning.quote: The adservice container serves only gRPC (HTTP/2) on port 9555, as confirmed by the readinessProbe using grpc and the Service port named grpc. The livenessProbe is misconfigured to use httpGet against the same port, sending HTTP/1.x requests to an HTTP/2-only server. Netty rejects these with Http2Exception 'Unexpected HTTP/1.x request: GET /', the kubelet liveness probe fails repeatedly (9 Unhealthy events), and kubelet kills and restarts the container (exit code 143, restart count 2). The port and timing are correct; only the protocol is wrong, so the root cause is liveness_probe_incorrect_protocol.
